ui.captured_officer.speech_accept.zhHant: 時勢已變。若你肯善待於我，我願歸降效力。
ui.captured_officer.speech_accept.en: Times have changed. Treat me well, and I will serve you.

ui.captured_officer.speech_kill_me.zhHant: 我不願背棄舊主。若無他路，便請賜我一死。
ui.captured_officer.speech_kill_me.en: I will not betray my former lord. If there is no other path, grant me death.

ui.captured_officer.speech_defiant.zhHant: 休想勸我變節。你若要處置，便痛快些。
ui.captured_officer.speech_defiant.en: Do not think to sway me. If you mean to judge me, then be swift.

ui.captured_officer.speech_offer_more.zhHant: 若真想我歸順，就拿出誠意與位置來談。
ui.captured_officer.speech_offer_more.en: If you truly want my allegiance, come with sincerity and a worthy place.

ui.captured_officer.speech_wait_and_see.zhHant: 是生是死，全在你一念。若肯留我，來日未必無用。
ui.captured_officer.speech_wait_and_see.en: Life or death rests on your will. Spare me, and I may yet prove useful.

ui.captured_officer.recruit_prompt_summa.zhHant: 你準備招降「{0}」。先聽聽他在「{1}」的回應。
ui.captured_officer.recruit_prompt_summa.en: You are about to recruit "{0}". Hear their response in "{1}" first.

ui.captured_officer.free_prompt_summary.zhHant: 你準備釋放「{0}」。先聽聽他在「{1}」的回應。
ui.captured_officer.free_prompt_summary.en: You are about to free "{0}". Hear their response in "{1}" first.

ui.captured_officer.kill_prompt_summary.zhHant: 你準備處決「{0}」。先聽聽他在「{1}」的最後之言。
ui.captured_officer.kill_prompt_summary.en: You are about to execute "{0}". Hear their final words in "{1}" first.

ui.captured_officer.jail_prompt_summary.zhHant: 你準備將「{0}」下獄。先聽聽他在「{1}」的回應。
ui.captured_officer.jail_prompt_summary.en: You are about to jail "{0}". Hear their response in "{1}" first.

ui.captured_officer.free_speech.zhHant: 既然放我一條生路，這筆情分我記下了。來日若再相逢，自有定數。
ui.captured_officer.free_speech.en: Since you spare my life, I will remember this debt. If we meet again, fate will decide the rest.

ui.captured_officer.kill_speech.zhHant: 成敗到此為止，我已無可再言。只願後人知我並未失節。
ui.captured_officer.kill_speech.en: My road ends here. Let it at least be known that I did not abandon my honor.

ui.captured_officer.jail_speech.zhHant: 要關便關吧。人還活著，總還有再見天日的時候。
ui.captured_officer.jail_speech.en: Then imprison me if you must. So long as I live, I may yet see daylight again.
